records.quote: If y ∝ x then y = m x
records.claim: If y varies directly as x then y = m x; and if y = m x then y ∝ x.
records.formula: $y \propto x \Rightarrow y = mx$ and $y = mx \Rightarrow y \propto x$

records.quote: If y ∝ x then y = 14 when x = 42, then find
records.label: Example
records.stem: If $y \propto x$ then $y = 14$ when $x = 42$, then find first: the relation between x and y; second: find the value of y when $x = 60$.
solution: First: $\because y \propto x$, $\therefore y = mx$ (where m constant $\neq 0$)
Substitute for the values of x and y in the relation: $\therefore 14 = 42 \times m$, $\therefore m = \frac{14}{42} = \frac{1}{3}$, $\therefore$ the relation is: $y = \frac{1}{3}x$

records.label: Example
records.quote: Connecting with Physics : If the relation between velocity (v)
records.stem: Connecting with Physics: If the relation between velocity (v) in (m/sec) and time t (sec) is $v = 9.8\,t$. First: determine the kind of variation between v and t. Second: A Find the values of v when t = 2 seconds, t = 4 seconds. B Find the value of t when v = 24.5 m/sec.
solution: First: $\because v = \text{constant} \times t$, i.e. $v \propto t$, i.e. v directly changes with t.
Second: A when t = 2 then $v = 9.8 \times 2 = 19.6$ m/s
B When V = 24.5 then $24.5 = 9.8 \times t$ $\therefore t = \frac{24.5}{9.8} = 2.5$ seconds.

parts.answer: v varies directly with t ($v \propto t$)

objectives.label: Recognize an inverse variation
objectives.description: Show that xy is constant, write y = m/x, and note that its graph is not a straight line.

objectives.label: Solve inverse variation problems
objectives.description: Find the relation between x and y and an unknown value using y1/y2 = x2/x1.

objectives.label: Decide the kind of variation and apply it
objectives.description: Decide from tables or formulas whether a relation is direct, inverse or neither, and solve physics and geometry problems with it.
